title: fix: stop serving empty cached responses from the legacy caches
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The legacy image and text caches now treat zero-byte R2 objects as misses, so a subsequent GET can replace an empty cached response without bucket cleanup. HEAD responses are no longer stored in either cache: text HEAD misses go directly to the origin, while the image cache skips storing HEAD responses. A text HEAD miss no longer includes X-Cache: MISS or X-Cache-Key headers. Regression tests cover both caches.
